text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 720-725 per dollar, softer from its 715-720 in the morning, with dollar demand outstripping supply in an illiquid interbank market, dealers said.
"A large fuel importer was bidding for large dollar volumes but supply was scarce and the lev lost some 20-25 from yesterday," one dealer said. The lev closed at 698-702 per dollar on Thursday.
The client's bids were not fully covered today and pressure on the lev was expected to mount on Monday, dealers said.
Traders attributed the low foreign currency supply to banks' reluctance to pare forex positions in the current political situation.
The central bank was not seen supporting the lev through dollar sales today, dealers said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
